_comment: Sample blueprint shaped exactly like the backend `content_blueprint` (see Backend-Server/.../message_generator_from_scratch_v0_1.py line 693 `class SectionSpec`). Synthetic Opdivo-style HCP email for adjuvant NSCLC, used only for offline pipeline testing — no real patient/marketing data.

content_blueprint.intent: Open with a credible greeting that frames why this HCP should read on.
content_blueprint.headline: Dear Healthcare Professional,
content_blueprint.copy_outline: A short, professional greeting that signals this is an evidence-led update on adjuvant therapy choices in resected NSCLC, not a promotional blast.
content_blueprint.clinical_fact_covered: Greeting / framing only — no clinical claim.

content_blueprint.intent: Anchor the email on the headline benefit and the trial it comes from, with a clear visual hook.
content_blueprint.headline: Adjuvant therapy that delayed recurrence in resected stage IB–IIIA NSCLC
content_blueprint.copy_outline: Pull the topline DFS benefit from the pivotal trial: hazard ratio with 95% CI, statistical significance, and the patient population. Pair with a hero image that conveys clinical confidence (chest CT motif, clinician-patient scene, or trial-arms data viz).
content_blueprint.clinical_fact_covered: Disease-free survival (DFS) benefit of adjuvant immunotherapy vs. placebo, pivotal Phase 3 readout.

content_blueprint.intent: Reinforce mechanism of action — why this drug, biologically.
content_blueprint.headline: Designed to restore T-cell anti-tumor activity
content_blueprint.copy_outline: Two-column layout: short MoA copy on one side and an illustrative MoA diagram on the other. Mention PD-1 / PD-L1 axis, T-cell reactivation, and tumor microenvironment effect. Use 1–2 short clinical sentences, not a paragraph.
content_blueprint.clinical_fact_covered: PD-1 pathway inhibition leads to restored T-cell activity against tumor cells.

content_blueprint.intent: Show the efficacy data prominently — visually credible, scannable.
content_blueprint.headline: Significant DFS improvement vs. placebo in the ITT population
content_blueprint.copy_outline: Two or three data callout boxes: median DFS (drug arm), median DFS (placebo arm), and hazard ratio with 95% CI. Add a small Kaplan-Meier-style figure as an image asset. Each statistic carries a citation superscript.
content_blueprint.clinical_fact_covered: Median DFS values in both arms and the hazard ratio.

content_blueprint.intent: Provide fair balance — common AEs and discontinuation rate visible alongside efficacy.
content_blueprint.headline: Safety profile observed in the adjuvant setting
content_blueprint.copy_outline: List the top 3 treatment-related AEs (≥10% incidence) and the all-grade discontinuation rate. Keep the table visually equal in weight to the efficacy callouts — do not let it shrink into the footer.
content_blueprint.clinical_fact_covered: Most common treatment-related adverse events and discontinuation rates.

content_blueprint.intent: Important Safety Information section — regulatory requirement.
content_blueprint.headline: IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION
content_blueprint.copy_outline: Full required-language ISI placeholder text. Must include boxed warning (if any), contraindications, warnings/precautions, common AEs, and a link to the full Prescribing Information. Render at 10px, clearly delimited from preceding sections.

content_blueprint.intent: One unambiguous next step for the HCP.
content_blueprint.headline: Review the full prescribing information
content_blueprint.copy_outline: Single solid CTA button — brand-color background, white text — linking to the PI. Avoid stacking secondary CTAs.

content_blueprint.intent: Short professional closing and references block.
content_blueprint.headline: References
content_blueprint.copy_outline: Numbered references corresponding to the superscript citations in the efficacy and hero sections. 10px, neutral color, full citation format.
